description: This PHP source file defines a class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator, which implements a decorator pattern for a cache object related to HTMLPurifier's definition cache. It contains methods for decorating, copying, and proxying cache operations such as add, set, replace, get, remove, flush, and cleanup.
